purpose: Printed station labels of the suburban timetable sheets that do not match an OSM station name letter for letter: abbreviations and Indian Railways station codes expanded to the station's name. Read by build_suburban_timetable_feed.py; a label absent here and unmatched refuses the build.
basis: Each expansion is checked against the sheet's own station order: the codes of the trans-harbour sheet (cr_public_trans_harbour_20240113) run Thane, Digha Gaon, Airoli, Rabale, Ghansoli, Kopar Khairane, Turbhe, Sanpada, Vashi, Juinagar, Nerul, Seawoods-Darave, Belapur, Kharghar, Mansarovar, Khandeshwar, Panvel, the order of the OSM Trans-Harbour relations; the 15-car sheet's codes (cr_public_main_15_car_20260815) run CSMT, Byculla, Dadar, Kurla, Ghatkopar, Bhandup, Mulund, Thane, Diva, Dombivli, Kalyan, Vithalwadi, Ulhasnagar, Ambernath, Badlapur, Vangani, Shelu, Neral, Bhivpuri Road, Karjat, Palasdhari, Kelavli, Dolavli, Lowjee, Khopoli, the order of the Central Line relations; the abbreviations of the WR pocket timetable are its own (M'BAI CENTRAL (L) = Mumbai Central local platforms, Mahim Jn. = Mahim Junction). Misprints on the sheets are kept as printed and expanded here (CHUCHGATE, CHERNI ROAD, MERINE LINE, KEVE ROAD, MUM'AI CENTRAL(L) on the WR Dahanu Road sheet; DLY for Dolavli on the CR 15-car sheet's up page, DLV on its down page). The OSM stop-position names of the route relations are the targets (Nalla Sopara, Koparkhairne, Baman-Dongri, Seawoods, Mumbai Central (local)).

skipped.GAVHAN: the Nerul-Uran line's Gavhan station is not in the OSM extract of 15 September 2026 (no station or stop node); the train's other stops are kept
